tips.text: Bank Hex Treasures and turn them in to Leticia on days you do not play; they only count against the cap when handed in.
Keep one of each 750-standing treasure for the Rank 3 sacrifice instead of turning every one in.
Run the six bounties on Steel Path; doing all six there nearly fills the daily cap on its own.
Bring Parallax air support and a loot radar on treasure runs, and listen for the treasure sound.
Expect the least grindy syndicate: players report maxing The Hex in a week or two, gated only by the daily cap.
